name: Knowledge Base
description: Everything the AI knows about the business, as one workspace: a rail of knowledge sources beside the selected source's page. Business profile with opening hours, free-text business notes with starter templates, FAQs as a searchable reorderable table with bulk actions and undo, the products catalog with photos, read-only mirrors of the services and staff that Bookings owns, import from a file or pasted text, CSV and JSON export, a character-budget breakdown across the sources, a quality lint, and Gaps - the questions the assistant handed to a human, clustered into a list of FAQs worth writing.

permissions.requiredFor: editing the business profile, the business notes, FAQs and the catalog
the Gaps source, which reads conversations to find questions the assistant handed to a human
